sections.title: Api overview
sections.content:
This guide explains how to add new participants to a throttle Schedule, the ideal tool for controlling the recipients on your throttled schedules. Recipients can be only be added when the status of the throttle schedule is active or paused.

Before you start your implementation, please check you have your Account, API Key and Base URL set up and have familiarised yourself with our implementation prerequisites in our Introduction documentation.

sections.title: Headers
sections.content:
These parameters are mandatory to be provided in the header of your request. If not provided, or incorrect, your request will fail.

HeaderTypeDescription
X-Api-KeyStringAPI Key value for authorisation
AccountReferenceStringYour Esendex account reference - e.g. SPNL000000
Content-TypeStringapplication/json

Example request header:
POST https://api.spryng.nl/v2/throttle-schedule{throttleScheduleId}/recipients
-H 'Api-Key: YOUR_API_KEY'
-H 'AccountReference: SPNL000000'
-H 'Content-Type: application/json'

sections.title: Request body
sections.content:
You can use the cURL sample provided on the right hand side of this page to directly copy/paste into your chosen integration tool, using the below properties to modify your request as required for your business needs.

Required, or Conditional, Request body parameters

If a required parameter is not provided, or incorrect, the request will fail. If a parameter is Conditional, it is only required for certain channels or is dependent on the desired format of the message.

ParameterTypeRequired or ConditionalDescription
msisdnJSON arrayConditionalEither "recipients" or "contacts" must be provided. Can contain an array of recipient objects
contacts.contacts.idGUIDConditionalThe contactId of the contacts you wish to send your message to


Optional request body parameters

These parameters are not mandatory within the request body, they are designed to provide you further capability to customise or filter your requests.

ParameterTypeDescription
recipients.metadataJSON objectCan contain "key": "value" pairs. These are saved with the message and will be returned when exporting the message history. This can make some data analysis easier
recipients.variablesJSON objectCan contain "key": "value" pairs. These are saved with the message and will be returned when exporting the message history. This can make some data analysis easier


Request body example

{
      "recipients": [
          {
              "msisdn": "+14155550123",
              "variables": {
                  "firstName": "Alex",
                  "orderId": "A12345",
                  "deliveryDate": "2025-08-20"
              },
              "metaData": {
                  "campaignId": "SUMMER-2025",
                  "source": "web",
                  "locale": "en-US"
              }
          }
      ]
  }

sections.title: Responses
sections.content:
The standard responses for this API are listed below. For a full list of possible REST API status codes, please refer to this guide.

Success
201 Created
Indicates that the request has been completed.
{
    "data": {
      "throttleScheduleId": "3fa85f64-5717-4562-b3fc-2c963f66afa6",
      "estimatedEndDateTime": "2025-08-14T09:30:04.596Z",
      "estimatedRateOfSend": 0,
      "numberOfRecipients": 0
    }


Error Codes
400 Bad Request
The server could not understand the request due to incorrect syntax or an incorrect/missing required property. You should not repeat the request without modifications.
{
    "errors": [
      {
        "errorCode": "string",
        "errorMessage": "string"
      }
    ]
  }

401 Unauthorized
Indicates that the request has failed due to missing or incorrect authentication information. You can repeat the request with a suitable authorization header field.
